hook.name: FarmIndexFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based dynamic fee hook for ETH/token pairs launched via FarmIndexLauncher. Charges ETH fees on swap input for buys (beforeSwap) and on ETH output for sells (afterSwap), with the fee rate scaling between a configured base and max BPS based on the previous swap's tick movement. Fees are sent directly to the pool's fee recipient on every swap.
